title: when a slice's rule tests the branch diff's paths, have test harnesses include the run's own tracking paths by default

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`noRendersHarness` (`internal/engine/uipass_test.go:897-915`) routes `git diff --name-only` with only the paths a test lists. A real run's branch diff also carries the run's own tracking files, `.slicer/` and `landed-changed/` (adj 600). So a rule that tests the diff's paths, such as `onlyTUITestFiles`, never saw them in the harness. That hid the defect in S584: the "No renders expected" rule never matched a real run. The owner decided (adj 602, key `tests.diff-harness-tracking-paths`, "Shared default") that harnesses get these paths through one shared helper in `internal/engine/harness_test.go`. The helper prepends the tracking paths by default. A test opts out for a diff that must list no tracking paths. `noRendersHarness` uses the helper.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-26: adj 602 (shared diff-route helper prepends tracking paths) and adj 607 (only noRendersHarness converts in this slice).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/harness_test.go:184-190` (`harnessOpts`; add the diff-route helpers and four regression tests beside it)
- `internal/engine/uipass_test.go:895-915` (`noRendersHarness` builds its diff route through the helper)
- `internal/engine/uipass_test.go:932-957` (`TestUIPassBriefSaysNoRendersWhenOnlyTUITestsChanged` drops explicit tracking paths)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestDiffRouteAddsTrackingPaths: diffRoute(W, "base", "internal/tui/x_test.go") returns the exact git -C W diff --name-only -z --no-renames --no-relative base route, with NUL-terminated .slicer/index.json, landed-changed/S04.md and internal/tui/x_test.go in order.
- TestDiffRouteExactListsOnlyGivenPaths: diffRouteExact returns the same route with only the given NUL-terminated path.
- TestDiffRouteWithNoPathsStillAddsTrackingPaths: diffRoute(W, "base") lists only the two tracking paths.
- TestNoRendersHarnessDiffCarriesTrackingPaths: start noRendersHarness with only internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go; assert the engine made the exact diff call against h.fake, replay that call to assert its real NUL-terminated output includes the tracking paths, and assert the UI brief holds "## No renders expected". The output assertion fails against the old harness.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/harness_test.go`, add `diffRoute(W, base string, changed ...string) clitest.Route`. It returns `clitest.Route{Tool: "git", Args: {"-C", W, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", "--no-renames", "--no-relative", base}}` with Stdout set to NUL-terminated paths. The list is `.slicer/index.json`, `landed-changed/` + `item` + `.md`, then `changed` in order. Add a doc comment citing adj 600 and adj 602.
2. In the same file, add `diffRouteExact(W, base string, changed ...string) clitest.Route`, the opt-out for a diff that must list no tracking paths. It builds the same route with only the given paths. `diffRoute` calls it with the two tracking paths placed before `changed`.
3. In `internal/engine/uipass_test.go`, `noRendersHarness` builds `diff` with `diffRoute(W, "base", changed...)`. When `len(changed) == 0` it keeps the existing branch (Stdout "", Exit 1), so `TestUIPassBriefHasNoRendersNoteWhenTheDiffCannotBeRead` still gets an unreadable diff. Update its doc comment: the routed diff lists the run's tracking paths, then the given paths.
4. In `TestUIPassBriefSaysNoRendersWhenOnlyTUITestsChanged`, pass only `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go` to `noRendersHarness`. Remove the explicit `.slicer/index.json` and `landed-changed/` + `item` + `.md` arguments, and update the comment above the call.
5. Add the four tests under Failing tests to `internal/engine/harness_test.go`, with the first three calling the helpers directly.
6. Leave the other routed `git diff --name-only` sites (`baseOverlayRoutes`, `brief_test.go:1911` and `:2092`, `decisionpaths_test.go:59`) as they are. See Owner needed.
7. Run `gofmt -l .`, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run TestDiffRouteAddsTrackingPaths ./internal/engine` passes (it fails to compile before the change).
- `go test -run TestDiffRouteExactListsOnlyGivenPaths ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestDiffRouteWithNoPathsStillAddsTrackingPaths ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestNoRendersHarnessDiffCarriesTrackingPaths ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefSaysNoRendersWhenOnlyTUITestsChanged ./internal/engine` passes with the shorter argument list.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefHasNoRendersNoteWhenTheDiffCannotBeRead ./internal/engine` passes (no paths still means an unreadable diff).
- `go test ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l internal` prints nothing.
